messages.content: Now I need the hotel for St. Louis, Monday October 12 through Thursday October 15. Please compare the full three-night cost, not just the nightly rate, and make sure Thursday luggage storage will work.

I found two practical choices for the Forest Park assignment. The Cheshire is close enough to reach the museum on foot Tuesday morning. Its flexible king rate is $189 per night, breakfast is separate, and cancellation is allowed until 6:00 p.m. Sunday, October 11. Pear Tree Inn St. Louis Near Union Station is less expensive and includes breakfast, but Tuesday's trip requires MetroLink followed by a bus transfer. I can calculate the taxes and map both morning trips before you choose.
Do that. Include every mandatory hotel charge, and show what breakfast at the Cheshire would add.

For three nights, the Cheshire room subtotal is $567. Estimated lodging taxes are $96.39, with no mandatory resort or destination fee, producing a hotel total of $663.39. Breakfast is $22 per person before tax and gratuity. One breakfast with tax and an 18% gratuity would be about $28.45, so the stay plus Tuesday breakfast would be approximately $691.84.

At Pear Tree Inn, the room subtotal is $417 at $139 per night. Estimated lodging taxes are $70.89, and there are no additional mandatory property fees. The complete total is $487.89, including breakfast each morning. The difference is $175.50 before adding any Cheshire breakfast, or $203.95 if you eat breakfast there Tuesday.
What would Tuesday morning actually look like from each one? I have to be inside the museum by 8:00, not arriving at the edge of Forest Park then.

From the Cheshire, allow about 14 minutes for the 0.7-mile walk to the museum's staff entrance. Leaving at 7:35 a.m. should put you at that entrance around 7:49, with roughly 10 minutes of margin. A rideshare would usually take 4-7 minutes, but the walk is more predictable at that distance.

From Pear Tree Inn, the realistic transit plan is to leave the hotel at 6:38 a.m., walk about four minutes to Union Station MetroLink, take the 6:47 westbound train to Forest Park-DeBaliviere, then transfer to the 7:10 bus through the park. It is scheduled near the museum at 7:29, followed by a six-minute walk to the staff entrance. That gives about 25 minutes of margin, but the transfer is the vulnerable point. Missing the bus would require a rideshare to avoid being late.
How much transfer time is there? And check whether construction or weekday service changes make that itinerary unreliable.

The train is scheduled to reach Forest Park-DeBaliviere at 7:00, leaving 10 minutes for the bus connection. The bus stop is on the same side of the station complex but requires exiting the platform and walking roughly two minutes. Current weekday schedules show both services operating normally on October 13, and there is no posted construction affecting that segment. Still, a train delay of more than about seven minutes would make the connection uncomfortable.
Could I just take an earlier train without leaving at an absurd hour?

Yes. Leaving Pear Tree Inn at 6:18 would put you on the 6:27 train, arriving Forest Park-DeBaliviere at 6:40. The next useful park bus is at 6:51, reaching the museum area around 7:10. You would be at the staff entrance around 7:16. That removes most of the connection risk, but it means leaving the hotel 77 minutes before your report time.
All right. Now verify the luggage question directly for both. Checkout is Thursday morning, the review may run until 1:00, and my flight is at 4:15.

Both front desks confirmed complimentary luggage storage for registered guests after checkout on Thursday. The Cheshire will tag the suitcase and supply case at the desk; collection is available at any time that afternoon. Pear Tree Inn also holds luggage after checkout, but items must be retrieved by 6:00 p.m. Neither property requires an extra fee or a separate reservation for storage.
Work out Thursday timing too. The flight record says I should leave the museum by 1:30.

With the Cheshire, you could check out before the 9:30 review, leave both bags at the front desk, and walk to the museum. If the review ends at 1:00, the return walk and retrieval should have you ready for a car around 1:25. A rideshare to STL typically takes 18-25 minutes then, putting you at the terminal around 1:45-1:55.

With Pear Tree Inn, returning downtown for stored bags would add too much uncertainty. The sensible plan would be to check out, bring the bags to the museum, and use the museum's approved storage area during the review. Otherwise, museum-to-hotel-to-airport would likely put you at the terminal around 2:15-2:30, depending on traffic.
No, I asked for hotel luggage storage, so don't replace it with museum storage. Is there a clean hotel-storage plan from Pear Tree Inn that still respects the 1:30 departure?

Not a clean one. You would need the review to end closer to 12:30, take a car downtown, retrieve the bags, and leave Pear Tree Inn by about 1:25. If the review runs to 1:00, the downtown detour conflicts with the plan to leave the museum area by 1:30 and reduces your airport margin. The Cheshire is the only one of these two that makes hotel storage practical on Thursday without depending on an early finish.
That makes the price difference easier to understand. Confirm the rate terms again. Which one can I cancel over the weekend before arrival?

The Cheshire flexible rate can be canceled without penalty until 6:00 p.m. local time on Sunday, October 11. After that, the penalty is one night's room and tax. Pear Tree Inn's quoted advance-purchase rate becomes nonrefundable immediately after booking; its flexible rate is available, but it raises the three-night total to $548.22 and still does not solve Thursday's storage detour.
Is the Cheshire room total fixed at $663.39 even if I skip breakfast entirely? Also, I only need one room for myself on this work trip.

Yes. The $663.39 total is for one room and one guest for October 12-15: $567 in room charges plus $96.39 in lodging taxes. Breakfast is optional and is not bundled into the reservation, so skipping it does not change that total. There are no mandatory fees due at the property beyond the quoted amount.
Before booking, what time is check-in Monday? My Southwest flight lands at 2:05.

Standard check-in is 4:00 p.m. Your flight should put you at the hotel around 3:00-3:30, depending on the checked supply case and traffic. The hotel will hold both bags if the room is not ready, and the reservation notes that you may arrive before 4:00. There is no early-check-in charge unless you request a guaranteed room before the standard time.
Book the Cheshire flexible king for the three nights. Use the payment method on file, and add the early-arrival note but don't pay to guarantee it. Please retain the Thursday storage note too.

The Cheshire flexible king room is booked for Avery Thompson for October 12-15, three nights. The confirmed total is $663.39, including all mandatory taxes and fees, charged to the payment method on file according to the property's payment schedule. Breakfast is not included. Free cancellation is available until 6:00 p.m. local time Sunday, October 11; after that, the penalty is one night's room and tax.

The reservation includes an expected arrival between 3:00 and 3:30 p.m. Monday, with complimentary bag holding if the room is not ready. Thursday checkout is at 11:00 a.m., and the front desk will store the suitcase and checked supply case until you retrieve them after the condition review. Confirmation: CHS-804621.
